declarations.name: SpadayDagre
declarations.summary: Directed graph rendered as themed SVG, laid out by dagre from a serializable node/edge config.

attributes.name: graph
attributes.description: The graph: {nodes: [{id, label, width, height, class}], edges: [{source, target, label, class}]}.

attributes.name: layout
attributes.description: dagre layout options: rankdir (TB/BT/LR/RL), align, nodesep, edgesep, ranksep, marginx, marginy, ranker.

attributes.name: zoomable
attributes.description: Wheel zoom (cursor-anchored), drag pan, and double-click reset; on by default.

attributes.name: controls
attributes.description: Overlay pan arrows and a center reset control on the graph; off by default.

attributes.name: transition
attributes.description: Re-layout transition duration in milliseconds (default 250); 0 disables, and reduced-motion preferences disable it automatically.

attributes.name: maxLabelWidth
attributes.description: Cap on a node label's measured width in px: wider labels stop widening the node and render ellipsized, with the full label as a native tooltip. Unset keeps natural widths.

events.name: dagre-node-click

type.text: CustomEvent<{id: string, label: string, x: number, y: number}>

events.description: A node was clicked; detail carries {id, label, x, y} with the pointer's client coordinates.

events.name: dagre-edge-click

type.text: CustomEvent<{source: string, target: string, label?: string, x: number, y: number}>

events.description: An edge was clicked; detail carries {source, target, label, x, y} with the pointer's client coordinates.

events.name: dagre-node-contextmenu

type.text: CustomEvent<{id: string, x: number, y: number}>

events.description: A node was right-clicked; detail carries {id, x, y} with the pointer's client coordinates, and the native context menu is suppressed over the shape.

events.name: dagre-edge-contextmenu

type.text: CustomEvent<{source: string, target: string, label?: string, x: number, y: number}>

events.description: An edge was right-clicked; detail carries {source, target, label, x, y} with the pointer's client coordinates, and the native context menu is suppressed over the shape.
